Messages.Author: David Cherryholmes
Messages.Body:
Can Ezmerelda's special be combined with Return to Innocence? It seems
you might be able to remove her from the game and trigger both effects
simultaneously.

Return to Innocence: [D] Bleed. If you successfully bleed your prey for
one or more, put this card on the acting vampire. Burn this card if this
vampire loses any blood or goes to torpor, or if your prey is
ousted. During your next untap, this vampire is removed from play and
your prey burns X pool, where X is the capacity of this vampire.

Ezmerelda: If Ezmerelda is ready during your untap phase, you may remove
her from the game to gain 11 pool.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <Pine.GSO.4.21.010703...@dirac.mc.duke.edu>,
David Cherryholmes <d...@petsparc.mc.duke.edu> writes

>
>Can Ezmerelda's special be combined with Return to Innocence?

No.

You order the effects of your untap phase as you want, but they have to
be ordered. Doing things all at once doesn't happen.

In this instance, you remove Ez for RtoI and then she isn't around for
her special. Or, you remove her for her special and both her and RtoI
aren't around to activate themselves as the next thing.

Basically, everything you do in V:TES resolves when you do it
(exceptions, strikes and actions, basically). You can't try and set up
and interrupt stack like Magic has had to try and burn things and
sacrifice them to something at the same time, etc
